text: Federal Pacific Insurance says its group consists of privately owned general insurance companies with offices and branches in Samoa, Tonga, Cook Islands, East Timor and Vanuatu. Cook Islands News names the late Alistair Hutchison as the group's founder and his son Papalii Alan Hutchison as chairman.
short: The Federal Pacific Insurance group says it is privately owned; Hutchison family.
